name: Red Wizards of Thay
description: Two Red Wizards on a secret mission into the High Moors, searching for something or someone.

timeline.summary: Two Red Wizards of Thay undertake a secret mission into the High Moors, escorted by mercenaries who think they should be stopped.
timeline.quote: Two Red Wizards of Thay have undertaken a secret mission into the High Moors east of the Sword Coast.

timeline.summary: Pursuing the wizards leads the adventurers to a barrow mound where a wizards' sanctum is being plundered.
timeline.quote: At the barrow, they discover the remnants of a wizards' sanctum still being plundered.

pages_say.description: Two Red Wizards on a secret mission into the High Moors, searching for something or someone.
